requirements.requirement: The system must accept a list of two or more provider identifiers and initiate a comparison computation.
The system must retrieve or invoke provider scoring results for each input provider using the EVAL-SCORE-PROV dependency.
The system must aggregate individual provider scores into a unified comparison dataset.
The system must normalize provider scores onto a common scale to enable fair comparison.
The system must rank providers based on normalized scores in descending order of quality.
The system must compute per-provider measure-level breakdowns using existing scoring outputs.
The system must identify relative strengths for each provider by comparing measure scores against peer providers in the same request.
The system must identify relative weaknesses for each provider by comparing measure scores against peer providers in the same request.
The system must incorporate explanation data from EVAL-EXPLAIN to support strength and weakness identification.
The system must produce deterministic ranking results given the same input providers and underlying score data.
The system must handle ties in normalized scores by applying a consistent secondary ordering rule or marking providers as tied.
The system must exclude or flag providers with missing or incomplete score data in the comparison output.
The system must return an error when fewer than two valid providers are supplied for comparison.
The system must gracefully handle failures from EVAL-SCORE-PROV or EVAL-EXPLAIN by returning a structured error without crashing.
The system must conform to the domain service pattern established in provider_detail_service.py for orchestration and logic separation.
